title: Take Me Back to Eden

personnel.name: Vessel
personnel.role: vocals, guitar, bass, keyboards, synthesizers, production

studio_context: Treehouse Studios, Chesterfield; the first record not produced by George Lever. Released 19 May 2023.

drum_performances.name: II
drum_performances.why_it_matters: The breakthrough: The Summoning's odd-meter riffs at 173 (bars of 3/4, 6/4, 6/4 and 4/4), its half-time chorus and the live solo of threes over sixteenths; Chokehold, Granite, Vore and the title track, which II played through for Drumeo.
